neighbours.label: The check / verify word family across languages (check, checker, vérifier, проверить), vs sentences that do the same task with another verb
fire: When the copy finishes, the script will check whether the target file exists.

predictions: check/checker/vérifier/проверить 0.3-0.8; the same sentences with print/take/stamp/change under 0.1.
notes: Card: ' Check' x8, 'checker' x3, 'ifie' (vérifiez), 'ровер' (проверка), Arabic فحص. Probe: vérifiez 0.839, проверку 0.566, check-that 0.481, spell checker 0.420, check output 0.403; 'look over' 0.014.
